scripts.build:core: cd apps/backend && go build -o bin/decm-backend core-api/cmd/main.go
scripts.docs:core: cd apps/backend && swag init -g core-api/cmd/main.go -o core-api/docs
scripts.gen-api:core: pnpm run docs:core && cd packages/api && pnpm install && pnpm generate:core
scripts.db:setup: pnpm run db:start && pnpm run db:wait && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run db:migrate:down && pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: rm -rf packages/database/go/generated && cd packages/database && sqlc generate
scripts.contract:build: cd apps/contracts && forge install && forge build
scripts.contract:build-and-generate: pnpm run contract:build-only && pnpm run contract:generate-go
scripts.contract:all: pnpm run contract:build && pnpm run contract:generate-types
scripts.contract:build:generate: pnpm run contract:build && pnpm run contract:generate-go && pnpm run contract:generate-types
scripts.contract:decm:setup:dev: cd apps/contracts && make deployDecmAccessManager ARGS='--network sepolia'
scripts.gen-icons:web: rm -rf apps/web/src/components/icons/gen && pnpm dlx @svgr/cli --typescript --icon --out-dir apps/web/src/components/icons/gen apps/web/src/assets/icons/*
scripts.test:core:coverage:report: cd apps/backend && go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./... && go tool cover -html=coverage.out
